name: branded-social-images
description: Build tooling for the Branded Social Images admin assets. Run `npm ci && npm run build` after changing anything in src/.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map src/admin.scss admin/admin.css && postcss admin/admin.css --no-map --use autoprefixer --replace && postcss admin/admin.css --no-map --use cssnano --output admin/admin.min.css

author: Acato
